name: Hindsight

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

components.m: a tiny hourglass worth 500 GP, consumed

summary: You watch what happened within 500 feet of you over the last ten years, about a day each second at first, and can pause, rewind, slow or speed the visions while you concentrate. It's cast outside fights; the story tells what you see.
